sentences.en: Nine is a young age to start having suicidal thoughts.
sentences.zh: 九岁开始有自杀念头还太年轻。

sentences.en: Mennad told his parents about his suicidal thought.
sentences.zh: 梅纳德向父母透露了他有自杀的想法。

sentences.en: My best friend Marcelo has suicidal tendences.
sentences.zh: 我最好的朋友马塞洛有自杀倾向。

senses.zh: （想）自杀的，自杀性的,自我毁灭的，自取灭亡的,于己不利
